name: Sergius Paulus
title: The Seeking Proconsul
summary: Sergius Paulus was the Roman proconsul on Cyprus who met Paul and Barnabas during their first missionary journey. He was a wise man who sought to hear God's word, and despite opposition from the sorcerer Elymas, he came to faith when he saw the Lord's power.

keyEvents.title: Called Barnabas and Saulus
keyEvents.description: As proconsul on Cyprus, Sergius Paulus showed genuine interest in the gospel by sending for Barnabas and Saulus to hear God's word.

keyEvents.title: Met opposition from Elymas
keyEvents.description: The sorcerer Elymas (Bar-Jesus), who served the proconsul, tried to prevent Sergius Paulus from coming to faith.

keyEvents.title: Testified to God's judgment on Elymas
keyEvents.description: Sergius Paulus saw how Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, proclaimed judgment against Elymas, who was struck blind.

keyEvents.title: Came to faith
keyEvents.description: When the proconsul saw what happened and heard the Lord's teaching, he came to believe and was amazed by the teaching.
